purpose: Product utilization is evaluated in fixed 900-second wall-clock windows, independent of how many workers or handoffs cover the window. This prevents artificial worker-turn boundaries from distorting the SaaS-relevant KPI.

windows.basis: Epoch 18 substantive work started at 01:00:48 and fresh meaningful durable progress exists both before and after the 01:15 boundary. Final PASS requires automated confirmation that internal durable evidence gaps across the window are <=120 seconds.
Same epoch 18 remained actively productive across 01:15; continue collecting evidence until platform boundary or window end.

acceptance: Three consecutive audited fixed windows with >=840 seconds useful coverage establish the initial P0 utilization pass; worker count and handoff count do not matter. Thereafter retain as regression SLO.
